create_minhash_dedup_signature: create a MinhashDedupSignature pipeline block to generate minhash signatures from a set of documents
test_minhash_signature_consistency: test that minhash signatures are consistent across multiple MinhashDedupSignature instances with the same input
test_minhash_similarity_approximation: test that minhash Jaccard similarity approximation stays within 0.21 tolerance of actual text similarity
test_minhash_dedup_pipeline: test the full minhash dedup pipeline including signature generation, bucketing, clustering, and filtering
test_minhash_cluster_with_metadata: test that minhash clustering preserves cluster IDs and cluster sizes in document metadata
test_minhash_multiprocess_consistency: test that minhash bucketing produces identical duplicate pairs with 1 worker vs 10 workers
test_minhash_skip_existing_sigs: test that MinhashDedupSignature with skip_existing_sigs detects existing signatures and skips re-computation
test_minhash_corruption_detection: test that MinhashDedupSignature detects corrupted signature files during processing
